description:
Get sunrise, sunset, solar noon, dawn/dusk (civil), nautical dawn/dusk, astronomical dawn/dusk, golden hour, and day length for a location and date (or each day of a range if end_date is given).

Times are ISO UTC unless an IANA timezone is provided. At high latitudes some events may be null (e.g. no astronomical night in summer). Computed locally.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

end_date.description: Optional range end: one entry per day.

response_format.description: Output format: "markdown" for a readable summary table, "json" for the complete structured payload.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for output times (e.g. "America/New_York"). Defaults to UTC ISO timestamps.

name: astro_get_sun_times
title: Get Sun Times
